snippet.title: Kami Khazix
snippet.description:
Hello, I am KamiKhaZix 

Welcome to my youtube channel 

My youtube channel is a mix of educational league content, stream highlights, montages and full game commentary in high elo 


I am a live streamer on twitch
I stream everyday over at https://www.twitch.tv/kami_khazix

About me:
20 Years old 
Rank #1 Kha Zix EUNE & EUW 
Peaked Grand master 350 LP EUW 
Peaked Challenger 600 LP EUNE
Have over 3 mio mastery points on kha zix 

Hope you will enjoy my videos on this channel :)
